newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lion's Myers denies selling stake.
newsitem.headline: Lion's Myers denies selling stake.

text.p: Lion Nathan chief executive Douglas Myers said on Friday he was concerned at comments made by "certain sources" in Australia that he had been a seller or was planning to sell his interest in Lion Nathan.

"There are insinuations in these comments that a broker or a merchant bank may have, or may have had, a mandate in this regard. No banker or broker has, or has had, such a mandate. I am not contemplating selling any shares in Lion Nathan. I have not been approached by any parties," Myers said in a statement to the New Zealand Stock Exchange.
"These rumours are groundless and I am concerned that certain parties may be attempting to mislead the market, possibly for their own benefits," he said.
